falsification_conditions.condition: The price closes above the 2024_aug bottom pattern's previous high by 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by confirming a bullish trend contrary to the bottom pattern's implied consolidation

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day moving average crosses above the 50-day moving average by 3% or more
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a confirmed bullish momentum shift, directly contradicting the 'HOLD' signal's implication of continued sideways consolidation

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume surges to 200%+ of the 2024_aug bottom pattern's average daily volume for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume spike would indicate strong buying pressure invalidating the 'HOLD' signal's expectation of price stagnation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
